  • ಸಂಪರ್ಕ ಮಾಹಿತಿ (ಇಮೇಲ್ ವಿಳಾಸ ಮತ್ತು ಫೋನ್ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ).
  • ಹಣಕಾಸಿನ ಮಾಹಿತಿ (ನಿವ್ವಳ ಮೌಲ್ಯ ಅಥವಾ ಆದಾಯದ ವಿವರ), ಅನ್ವಯಿಸಿದರೆ. [ಗ್ರಾಹಕರ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಅಗತ್ಯವಿದೆ: ಇದನ್ನು ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆಯೇ ಎಂದು ಖಚಿತಪಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.]
  • ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್ (ಸಾಲಾರ್ಹತೆ) ಮಾಹಿತಿ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ. [ಗ್ರಾಹಕರ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಅಗತ್ಯವಿದೆ: ಇದನ್ನು ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆಯೇ ಎಂದು ಖಚಿತಪಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಬಂಧಿತ ಉದ್ದೇಶವನ್ನು ನಮೂದಿಸಿ.]

ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಣೆಯ ಮೂಲಗಳು

  • NSDL. [ಗ್ರಾಹಕರ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಅಗತ್ಯವಿದೆ: NSDL ಸಕ್ರಿಯ ಮೂಲವಾಗಿದೆಯೇ ಎಂದು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ.]
  • ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ, ಶಾಸನಬದ್ಧ ಅಥವಾ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಕ ಪ್ರಾಧಿಕಾರಗಳು ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುವ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಗಳು (ಡೇಟಾಬೇಸ್‌ಗಳು). [ಗ್ರಾಹಕರ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಅಗತ್ಯವಿದೆ: ಅನ್ವಯವಾಗುವ ಮೂಲಗಳನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ.]
  • ಆನ್‌ಬೋರ್ಡಿಂಗ್ ಘಟಕ ಅಥವಾ ಬಳಕೆದಾರರು.

ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಹಂಚಿಕೆ

{{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} ಶಾಸನಬದ್ಧ, ನಿಯಂತ್ರಕ ಮತ್ತು ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಪ್ರಾಧಿಕಾರಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ; ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾರ್ಯಾಚರಣೆಯ ಉದ್ದೇಶಗಳಿಗಾಗಿ ನಿಯೋಜಿಸಲಾದ ಸೇವಾ ಪೂರೈಕೆದಾರರೊಂದಿಗೆ; ಮತ್ತು ಕಂಪನಿಯು ಒದಗಿಸುವ ಸೇವೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸುಗಮಗೊಳಿಸುವಲ್ಲಿ ತೊಡಗಿರುವ ಪಕ್ಷಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ದತ್ತಾಂಶವನ್ನು ಹಂಚಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಅಧಿಕಾರವನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿದೆ. [ಗ್ರಾಹಕರ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಅಗತ್ಯವಿದೆ: ಪ್ರತಿ ವರ್ಗಕ್ಕೂ ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸುವವರು, ಉದ್ದೇಶಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಕಾನೂನು ಆಧಾರವನ್ನು ಖಚಿತಪಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.]

ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಮಾಲೀಕರ (Data Principal) ಹಕ್ಕುಗಳು

ನಿಮ್ಮ ಸಮ್ಮತಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸಂಸ್ಕರಿಸಲಾದ ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ದತ್ತಾಂಶವನ್ನು ತಿದ್ದುಪಡಿ ಮಾಡಲು, ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಲು, ನವೀಕರಿಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ಅಳಿಸಲು ನೀವು ಕೋರಬಹುದು ಹಾಗೂ ಯಾವುದೇ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಮ್ಮತಿಯನ್ನು ಹಿಂಪಡೆಯಬಹುದು. ಈ ಹಕ್ಕುಗಳನ್ನು ಚಲಾಯಿಸಲು, ಕಂಪನಿಯನ್ನು ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಪರ್ಕಿಸಿ [ಗ್ರಾಹಕರ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಅಗತ್ಯವಿದೆ: ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿದ DPO ಅಥವಾ ಕುಂದುಕೊರತೆ ನಿವಾರಣಾ ಇಮೇಲ್ ಅನ್ನು ನಮೂದಿಸಿ].

ಸಮ್ಮತಿಯನ್ನು ಹಿಂಪಡೆಯುವ ಕೋರಿಕೆಯ ಹೊರತಾಗಿಯೂ, ಅನ್ವಯವಾಗುವ ಕಾನೂನಿನಿಂದ ನಿಗದಿಪಡಿಸಲಾದ ಅವಧಿಯವರೆಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮ್ಮತಿಯನ್ನು ಹಿಂಪಡೆಯುವ ಮೊದಲು ಪ್ರಾರಂಭಿಸಲಾದ ವಹಿವಾಟುಗಳಿಗಾಗಿ ಕಂಪನಿಯು ದತ್ತಾಂಶವನ್ನು ಉಳಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಬಹುದು. ದೂರು ಅಥವಾ ಕುಂದುಕೊರತೆಗಾಗಿ, ಇವರನ್ನು ಸಂಪರ್ಕಿಸಿ [ಗ್ರಾಹಕರ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಅಗತ್ಯವಿದೆ: ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿದ ಕುಂದುಕೊರತೆ ನಿವಾರಣಾ ಸಂಪರ್ಕ ವಿವರ]. ಬಗೆಹರಿಯದ ದೂರುಗಳನ್ನು ಅನ್ವಯವಾಗುವ ಕಾನೂನಿನ ಪ್ರಕಾರ 'ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಸಂರಕ್ಷಣಾ ಮಂಡಳಿ'ಗೆ (Data Protection Board) ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಬಹುದು. [ಗ್ರಾಹಕರ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಅಗತ್ಯ: ಪ್ರಕಟಿಸುವ ಮೊದಲು ಮೂಲ ನಮೂನೆಯಲ್ಲಿರುವ 90 ದಿನಗಳ ಅವಧಿಯ ಸಂಬಂಧಿತ ನಿಯಮಾವಳಿಯನ್ನು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ.]

ಘೋಷಣೆ

ಈ ಸಮ್ಮತಿ ಪತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ನಾನು ಅರ್ಥಮಾಡಿಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದೇನೆ ಮತ್ತು 'ದತ್ತಾಂಶದ ಮೂಲ ಮಾಲೀಕ'ನ (data principal) ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಸಮ್ಮತಿಸುತ್ತೇನೆ ಎಂದು ಘೋಷಿಸುತ್ತೇನೆ. ಆ್ಯಪ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿನ ಒಪ್ಪಿಗೆಯ ಚೆಕ್‌ಬಾಕ್ಸ್ (checkbox), ಮೂಲ ನಮೂನೆಯಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಕಾಗದದ ಮೇಲಿನ ಸಹಿ, ಹೆಸರು ಮತ್ತು ಹುದ್ದೆಯ ವಿವರಗಳ ಜಾಗವನ್ನು ಬದಲಾಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. [ಗ್ರಾಹಕರ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಅಗತ್ಯ: ಎಲೆಕ್ಟ್ರಾನಿಕ್ ಒಪ್ಪಿಗೆಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ವಾಕ್ಯರಚನೆಯನ್ನು ಅನುಮೋದಿಸಿ.]

Fleet Manager Terms & Conditions

EVsEye Fleet Manager App | Fleet operator: {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}
Draft version: 1.0.0 | Effective date: to be assigned at publication

[CLIENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Confirm client legal name, contacts, authority and escalation rules, enabled financial actions, and legal approval before publication.]

1. Who these terms apply to

These terms govern access to the EVsEye Fleet Manager App by an individual authorised by {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} to manage its fleet operations. “{{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}” means the fleet operator identified in the applicable employment or service arrangement. “EV Spares” means EV Spares India Pvt Ltd, which provides the EVsEye platform. “You” means the authorised Fleet Manager. These terms govern use of the App; your employment, compensation, and authority to act for {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} are governed by your separate arrangement with {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}.

2. Account and authority

Use only the account assigned to you. Keep your phone, OTPs, and access credentials secure; do not share them or allow another person to work under your identity. Your access is limited to the locations, riders, vehicles, and actions assigned by {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}. Inform {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} promptly if your device, account, or credentials are lost or compromised. {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} may change your role or withdraw access when your duties change.

3. Operational records and decisions

Enter accurate, timely information about rider onboarding, identity and document review, vehicle inspection, allocation, handover, return, incidents, maintenance, and other enabled workflows. Check original evidence where {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s procedure requires it. Do not approve, reject, change, or delete a record without a legitimate operational reason. Record the reason for significant decisions when the App asks for one. A status shown by the App is an operational record, not a substitute for any required physical check, signed agreement, or legal approval.

4. Vehicles, riders, and safety

Follow {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s safety, inspection, allocation, and escalation procedures. Do not release an unsafe or ineligible vehicle, override a failed check, or knowingly allocate a vehicle to a person who has not met applicable requirements. Report accidents, theft, damage, battery issues, breakdowns, and suspected misuse promptly through the designated process. Use rider and vehicle information only to carry out authorised duties.

5. Documents, photographs, and verification

Upload only relevant and genuine documents and photographs. Do not alter evidence to misrepresent its content. Where the App offers third-party verification, treat the result as one part of the applicable review process and follow {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s procedure for exceptions. Do not download, copy, forward, or store rider identity documents outside approved systems unless {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} expressly authorises it and a lawful purpose requires it.

6. Payments and financial records

If your role includes deposits, rent, refunds, wallet adjustments, or invoices, enter transactions accurately and use only approved payment channels. Do not request payment to a personal account, promise an undisclosed fee waiver, or make an unapproved adjustment. The App may record who performed an action and when. Any authority to collect or approve money comes from {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s separate policy and assigned permissions.

7. Confidentiality and personal information

Rider, staff, vehicle, financial, and business information visible in the App is confidential. Access only records needed for your assigned work; do not use them for personal purposes or share them with unauthorised people. Follow {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s privacy and data-handling instructions and the Fleet Manager Privacy Policy presented separately in the App. Report an accidental disclosure or suspected data incident promptly. This clause does not prevent a disclosure required by law or a protected report to a competent authority.

8. Acceptable use

Do not impersonate another user, submit false information, manipulate location or vehicle data, bypass permissions, probe the service for vulnerabilities, introduce harmful software, or use the App for harassment or unlawful activity. Do not use automated access or extract bulk records without written authorisation. Use App features only for the purposes made available to your role.

9. Availability and changes

Features depend on {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s configuration and may change as its operations change. Connectivity, device, and third-party failures can interrupt access. Keep an appropriate manual escalation route for urgent safety decisions. Material changes to these terms will be presented for acceptance when required; the App records the version and time accepted.

10. Suspension and end of access

{{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} may suspend or end your access because of a role change, security concern, suspected misuse, or the end of your arrangement with {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}. Return company devices and records and stop using copied information when access ends, subject to lawful retention and reporting obligations. Suspected wrongdoing should be reviewed under {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s applicable process; an App restriction alone is not a final employment decision.

11. Responsibility and disputes

These terms do not remove rights or obligations that cannot legally be excluded. Your separate agreement with {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} controls employment or service matters. Indian law applies to these App terms, subject to mandatory law and the jurisdiction of legally competent courts or tribunals. Concerns about fleet operations should first be raised with {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}; platform access or technical concerns may be raised with EV Spares.

12. Contacts

{{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} fleet operations: [confirm legal name, postal address, authorised email, and support phone before publication].

EV Spares platform support: office@evsparesindia.com.

Notices may be sent through the App or to a contact address you provide, subject to applicable law.

Rider Privacy Policy

EVsEye Rider App | Fleet Operator: {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}
Effective date: 01 October 2026 | Version: 1.0.0

This Policy explains how personal information is used when a Rider uses the EVsEye Rider App for {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}. It applies to the features made available to that Rider. If a feature is not enabled, the information needed only for that feature is not requested through it.

1. Who is responsible for your information

{{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}, [CLIENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: client location], decides how Rider information is used for onboarding, identity and eligibility checks, vehicle allocation, payments, and fleet operations. EV Spares India Pvt Ltd independently decides how information is used for EVsEye account security, platform support, and service analytics. EV Spares also operates the EVsEye platform on {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s behalf for {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s Rider operations. Contact details for both organisations are in section 14.

2. Information we collect

Depending on the enabled service, information may include your name, mobile number, date of birth, address, photograph, emergency or reference contacts, driving licence, onboarding answers, vehicle allocation and usage, payment and wallet transactions, support requests, training completion, and referral records. Identity checks may use PAN, Aadhaar-related verification information, and bank-account verification information where requested in the App. The specific fields required for a feature are shown when you provide them.

3. Identity verification and Aadhaar

Where an identity check is required, verification information is shared with Sandbox, our KYC service provider, for the requested check. The platform stores verification results and masked identifiers needed to administer the check; identity numbers are not displayed publicly. Aadhaar verification, if enabled, is used only for the disclosed identity-check purpose. Riders may ask what verification information is held about them using the contact details below.

4. Location, vehicle IoT, and app permissions

If you choose to use nearby-hub features and grant location permission, the App uses your phone's location while the App is in use to find relevant hubs. The App does not collect phone location in the background for {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} Riders. A vehicle with GPS or IoT hardware can independently transmit its location, battery, speed, ignition, and other vehicle-status or safety events. That hardware can operate when the App is closed and may continue operating outside an active shift while powered. Vehicle IoT information is used for fleet operations, safety, maintenance, and theft or incident investigation.

5. Face verification

Face matching and liveness verification are not active for {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} Riders. If either is introduced, we will provide a separate explanation of the images and results collected, the provider, retention, and available choices before use.

6. Why we use information

{{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} uses Rider information to create and manage Rider accounts, verify identity and eligibility, allocate and administer vehicles, manage rent, deposits, invoices and payments, provide training and support, maintain vehicle safety, investigate incidents and suspected fraud, and meet applicable legal obligations. EV Spares uses information to secure accounts and the EVsEye service, respond to platform support requests, troubleshoot and improve service reliability, and analyse service use. Referral information is used only where a referral feature is enabled.

7. Notice, permissions, and choices

We present the information requested for each feature when it is collected. Where consent is required, it is requested for the stated purpose and may be withdrawn as applicable under law by contacting us. Optional phone-location permission can be denied or changed in your device settings; nearby-hub results may then be unavailable or less relevant. Withdrawal of information necessary to provide a requested Rider service may limit that service, subject to legal and contractual obligations.

8. Sharing and service providers

Information is shared only as needed for the purposes above with authorised {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} personnel and EV Spares platform personnel, and with service providers under appropriate access controls. Current or applicable providers include Sandbox for enabled KYC checks, Razorpay and Cashfree for payment processing, MSG91 for email delivery, and Amazon Web Services for hosting. Where a feature is enabled, an SMS provider may process a phone number and one-time code, and a map or routing service may process a location used for a route or nearby-hub search. A provider receives only the information needed for its task. Information may also be disclosed to insurers, maintenance partners, or authorities where needed for a service, claim, safety matter, or legal requirement.

9. Client separation and access

The platform separates {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s operational data from other fleet operators' data. Access is limited by user role and the operational task. EV Spares staff may access information for approved support, security, maintenance, or legal purposes; access is not represented as zero. Requests for emergency or legally compelled access are handled according to the applicable process.

10. Storage, retention, and security

Core platform information is hosted on Amazon Web Services infrastructure in India. The exact AWS region can vary by deployment. A service provider's processing location may differ; information about a specific provider can be requested using the contacts below. Access controls, audit records, and technical safeguards are used to protect information according to the service configuration.

KYC and identity-check records, vehicle GPS/IoT history, and support records are retained for up to one year from collection, unless a longer period is necessary for an active legal hold, investigation, dispute, or applicable law. Payment, invoice, tax, and accounting records are retained for the period required by applicable law; where GST record-keeping rules apply, this is generally at least 72 months from the due date of the annual return for the relevant year, and longer where proceedings require it. Account and active vehicle-allocation information is retained while needed to provide and administer the Rider service, then reviewed for deletion or de-identification subject to legal and dispute requirements. Retention and deletion are administered by the responsible teams.

11. Your rights and grievances

Subject to applicable law, you may request information about processing, correction or updating of inaccurate information, erasure where appropriate, withdrawal of consent where applicable, and resolution of a grievance. Send a request to the privacy contact in section 14. We may verify your identity before acting and may retain information when a legal obligation, live dispute, or other lawful ground requires it. Any applicable nomination right may be exercised through the same contact.

12. Age and eligibility

The Rider service is intended for adults aged 18 or older. {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} does not knowingly onboard a minor as a vehicle Rider. If information about a minor is submitted in error, contact us so it can be reviewed and corrected or deleted as appropriate.

13. Security incidents and policy changes

The responsible organisation will assess suspected security incidents and provide notices when required by applicable law. Material changes to this Policy will be communicated through the App or another appropriate channel. The current version and effective date will be shown with the Policy; renewed consent will be sought when required.

14. Contact details

{{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} (Rider operations), [CLIENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: client location]: [CLIENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: client support email], [CLIENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: client support phone]. Privacy and grievance contact: [CLIENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: client grievance officer], at the {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} contact above. EV Spares India Pvt Ltd (EVsEye platform): office@evsparesindia.com.

Rider Terms & Conditions

EVsEye Rider App | Fleet Operator: {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}

1.Definitions and parties

“Platform” means the EVsEye Rider App and supporting technology operated by {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}. “Fleet Operator” means {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}, the entity responsible for the vehicle and rider-facing rental/service arrangement. “Rider” means the individual using the App. Identify the actual contracting entities and their roles before publishing.

2.Eligibility and onboarding

Riders must be at least 18 years old, legally eligible to use the assigned vehicle, and hold a valid licence whenever required. Riders must provide accurate mobile, identity, address, licence and other onboarding details and update changes promptly. Approval and vehicle allocation may depend on verification and operator policies.

3.Account access and security

Access may use a registered mobile number and OTP. Riders must safeguard their devices and report suspected unauthorized access. Account access is personal and must not be sold or transferred.

4.Services and operator relationship

The App supports onboarding, verification, vehicle allocation, hubs, rentals, wallets, payments, maintenance reporting, referrals, training and support where enabled. Availability varies by Fleet Operator, city and subscribed package. The Fleet Operator, not the technology provider merely by operating the App, is responsible for the vehicle rental contract unless explicitly stated otherwise.

5.Vehicle use and safety

Follow traffic laws, safety requirements, vehicle capacity limits, manufacturer guidance and Fleet Operator instructions. Do not lend, sublet, tamper with, modify or use a vehicle or battery for unauthorized purposes. Report accidents, theft, damage, battery issues and breakdowns promptly.

6.Charges, rate cards and deposits

Applicable onboarding fees, rentals, penalties, taxes, refundable deposits, deductions and billing cycles must be shown before acceptance or transaction. Location, vehicle age/category and plan may affect prices only where disclosed in the applicable rate card. A deposit is not automatically forfeited and any deductions must be itemized under the signed rental agreement.

7.Wallet, payments and mandates

Wallet balances, credits, refunds, failed payments and adjustments are displayed in the App where offered. Payment gateways and mandate providers may process payments. UPI AutoPay or eNACH is optional unless clearly disclosed as a condition of a particular rental product; separate, revocable mandate authorization and provider rules apply. No debit beyond a valid authorization is permitted.

8.Location and connected vehicle information

Where vehicles are GPS/IoT enabled, trip, vehicle status, location and safety events may be processed as described in the Privacy Policy. Device or app location permissions must be explained in context. Do not claim tracking only occurs during shifts unless the deployed hardware and operations actually enforce this.

9.Referrals, rewards and training

Referral rewards, self-submission bonuses and training are governed by campaign-specific rules shown in the App, including eligibility, validation, expiry, fraud controls and payout timing. Rewards may be reversed for proven abuse subject to applicable law.

10.Prohibited activity

Do not submit forged documents, impersonate another person, manipulate GPS/odometer/telematics, misuse payment systems, compromise accounts, harass others or use services unlawfully.

11.Suspension and termination

Access may be restricted for safety, fraud, material breach, legal requirements or unpaid dues, with notice and an opportunity to respond where appropriate. On exit, return any allocated vehicle and equipment and complete an itemized settlement. Statutory rights and lawful dispute remedies remain unaffected.

12.Availability and liability

Service features may be interrupted for maintenance, network failures or external events. Nothing excludes liability or consumer rights that cannot lawfully be excluded. Any agreed limitation of liability must be reviewed for fairness and enforceability.

13.Updates and disputes

Material changes will be communicated before taking effect when required. Changes do not retroactively alter an accepted rental contract without appropriate consent. Indian law applies, subject to mandatory consumer protections and legally competent courts/tribunals.

14.Contact and notices

Fleet Operator: {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}, [CLIENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: client registered address], [CLIENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: client support email], [CLIENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: client support phone]. Platform support: office@evsparesindia.com, +91-9871675222. Grievance contact: [CLIENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: client grievance officer], office@evsparesindia.com, [CLIENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: client registered address]. Notices may be sent by in-app message, SMS or registered email, subject to applicable law.

Effective date and version

Effective date: 01 October 2026. Version: 1.0.0. The Fleet Operator and Platform will retain the version accepted by each Rider.

templates.content:
തുടരുന്നതിന് മുൻപ്

സ്വകാര്യതാ അറിയിപ്പും സമ്മതപത്രവും

ഡിജിറ്റൽ പേഴ്സണൽ ഡാറ്റാ പ്രൊട്ടക്ഷൻ ആക്ട് 2023 പ്രകാരം വ്യക്തിഗത വിവരങ്ങൾ ശേഖരിക്കുന്നതിനുള്ള സമ്മതപത്രം.

[ക്ലയന്റ് പരിശോധന ആവശ്യമാണ്: പ്രസിദ്ധീകരിക്കുന്നതിന് മുൻപ് ഡാറ്റാ ഫിഡ്യൂഷ്യറി (data fiduciary), DPO-യുടെ ബന്ധപ്പെടാനുള്ള വിവരങ്ങൾ, ഓരോ ഡാറ്റാ വിഭാഗം, ഉറവിടം, പങ്കിടലിന്റെ ഉദ്ദേശ്യം എന്നിവ സ്ഥിരീകരിക്കുക.]

ഡാറ്റ ശേഖരിക്കുന്നതിന്റെ ഉദ്ദേശ്യം

{{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}-ന്റെ സേവനങ്ങൾ പ്രയോജനപ്പെടുത്തുന്നതിനായി റൈഡർമാരെ പ്ലാറ്റ്‌ഫോമിൽ ഉൾപ്പെടുത്തുന്നതിനും (onboard), തുടർനടപടികൾ/ഇടപാടുകൾ സുഗമമാക്കുന്നതിനും.

ശേഖരിക്കുന്ന ഡാറ്റയുടെ തരങ്ങൾ

{{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} താഴെ പറയുന്ന വ്യക്തിഗത വിവരങ്ങൾ ശേഖരിക്കും:

തിരിച്ചറിയൽ വിവരങ്ങൾ (PAN, പേര്, പിതാവിന്റെ പേര്, ജനന തീയതി).

വിലാസം തെളിയിക്കുന്ന രേഖ (ആധാർ, ഡ്രൈവിംഗ് ലൈസൻസ്, പാസ്‌പോർട്ട് അല്ലെങ്കിൽ ഔദ്യോഗികമായി സാധുതയുള്ള മറ്റ് രേഖ).

ബന്ധപ്പെടാനുള്ള വിവരങ്ങൾ (ഇമെയിൽ വിലാസവും ഫോൺ നമ്പറും).

സാമ്പത്തിക വിവരങ്ങൾ (ആകെ ആസ്തി അല്ലെങ്കിൽ വരുമാന വിവരങ്ങൾ) - ബാധകമെങ്കിൽ. [ക്ലയന്റ് പരിശോധന ആവശ്യമാണ്: ഇത് ശേഖരിക്കുന്നുണ്ടോ എന്ന് സ്ഥിരീകരിക്കുക.]

ക്രെഡിറ്റ് വിവരങ്ങൾ. [ക്ലയന്റ് പരിശോധന ആവശ്യമാണ്: ഇത് ശേഖരിക്കുന്നുണ്ടോ എന്നും അതിന്റെ ഉദ്ദേശ്യമെന്തെന്നും സ്ഥിരീകരിക്കുക.]

ഡാറ്റ ശേഖരിക്കുന്നതിനുള്ള ഉറവിടങ്ങൾ

NSDL. [ക്ലയന്റ് പരിശോധന ആവശ്യമാണ്: NSDL ഒരു സജീവ ഉറവിടമാണെന്ന് ഉറപ്പുവരുത്തുക.]

സർക്കാർ, നിയമപരമായ സ്ഥാപനങ്ങൾ അല്ലെങ്കിൽ നിയന്ത്രണ അതോറിറ്റികൾ എന്നിവ പരിപാലിക്കുന്ന ഡാറ്റാബേസുകൾ. [ക്ലയന്റ് പരിശോധന ആവശ്യമാണ്: ബാധകമായ ഉറവിടങ്ങൾ തിരിച്ചറിയുക.]

ഓൺബോർഡിംഗ് നടത്തുന്ന സ്ഥാപനം അല്ലെങ്കിൽ ഉപയോക്താവ്.

ഡാറ്റ പങ്കിടൽ

നിയമപരമായ സ്ഥാപനങ്ങൾ, നിയന്ത്രണ അതോറിറ്റികൾ, സർക്കാർ അധികൃതർ; ബിസിനസ്സ്-പ്രവർത്തന ആവശ്യങ്ങൾക്കായി നിയോഗിക്കപ്പെട്ട സേവന ദാതാക്കൾ; കമ്പനി നൽകുന്ന സേവനങ്ങൾ സുഗമമാക്കുന്നതിൽ ഉൾപ്പെട്ടിരിക്കുന്ന കക്ഷികൾ എന്നിവരുമായി ഡാറ്റ പങ്കിടാൻ {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}-ന് അധികാരമുണ്ട്. [ക്ലയന്റ് പരിശോധന ആവശ്യമാണ്: ഓരോ വിഭാഗത്തിനും സ്വീകർത്താക്കൾ, ഉദ്ദേശ്യങ്ങൾ, നിയമപരമായ അടിസ്ഥാനം എന്നിവ സ്ഥിരീകരിക്കുക.]

ഡാറ്റാ പ്രിൻസിപ്പലിന്റെ (വിവര ഉടമയുടെ) അവകാശങ്ങൾ

നിങ്ങളുടെ സമ്മതത്തോടെ പ്രോസസ്സ് ചെയ്യുന്ന വ്യക്തിഗത വിവരങ്ങളിൽ തിരുത്തലുകൾ വരുത്താനോ, അപൂർണ്ണമായവ പൂർത്തിയാക്കാനോ, വിവരങ്ങൾ പുതുക്കാനോ, അവ നീക്കം ചെയ്യാനോ നിങ്ങൾക്ക് അഭ്യർത്ഥിക്കാം; കൂടാതെ എപ്പോൾ വേണമെങ്കിലും സമ്മതം പിൻവലിക്കാനും സാധിക്കും. ഈ അവകാശങ്ങൾ വിനിയോഗിക്കുന്നതിന്, കമ്പനിയുമായി [ക്ലയന്റ് പരിശോധന ആവശ്യമാണ്: സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ച DPO അല്ലെങ്കിൽ പരാതി പരിഹാര വിഭാഗത്തിന്റെ ഇമെയിൽ വിലാസം നൽകുക] എന്ന വിലാസത്തിൽ ബന്ധപ്പെടുക.

സമ്മതം പിൻവലിക്കാനുള്ള അഭ്യർത്ഥനയുണ്ടെങ്കിലും, ബാധകമായ നിയമം അനുശാസിക്കുന്ന കാലയളവിലേക്കും സമ്മതം പിൻവലിക്കുന്നതിന് മുൻപ് ആരംഭിച്ച ഇടപാടുകൾക്കായും കമ്പനിക്ക് ഡാറ്റ സൂക്ഷിക്കാവുന്നതാണ്. പരാതികളോ ആവലാതികളോ ഉണ്ടെങ്കിൽ [ക്ലയന്റ് പരിശോധന ആവശ്യമാണ്: സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ച പരാതി പരിഹാര കോൺടാക്റ്റ് വിവരങ്ങൾ] എന്നതിൽ ബന്ധപ്പെടുക. പരിഹരിക്കപ്പെടാത്ത പരാതികൾ ബാധകമായ നിയമപ്രകാരം 'ഡാറ്റാ പ്രൊട്ടക്ഷൻ ബോർഡി'ന് (Data Protection Board) സമർപ്പിക്കാവുന്നതാണ്. [ക്ലയന്റ് പരിശോധന ആവശ്യമാണ്: പ്രസിദ്ധീകരിക്കുന്നതിന് മുൻപ്, മൂലരൂപത്തിലെ (source form) 90 ദിവസത്തെ സമയപരിധിയുമായി ബന്ധപ്പെട്ട വ്യവസ്ഥ പരിശോധിക്കുക.]

പ്രഖ്യാപനം

ഈ സമ്മതപത്രത്തിലെ കാര്യങ്ങൾ ഞാൻ മനസ്സിലാക്കിയെന്നും, 'ഡാറ്റാ പ്രിൻസിപ്പൽ' (data principal) എന്ന നിലയിൽ ഇതിനോട് യോജിക്കുന്നുവെന്നും ഞാൻ പ്രഖ്യാപിക്കുന്നു. ആപ്പിനുള്ളിലെ സമ്മതം രേഖപ്പെടുത്തുന്നതിനുള്ള ചെക്ക്ബോക്സ് (checkbox), മൂലരൂപത്തിലെ പേപ്പർ ഒപ്പ്, പേര്, പദവി എന്നിവ രേഖപ്പെടുത്തുന്നതിനുള്ള ഇടങ്ങൾക്ക് പകരമായി ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്നു. [ക്ലയന്റ് പരിശോധന ആവശ്യമാണ്: ഇലക്ട്രോണിക് രീതിയിലുള്ള സമ്മതം രേഖപ്പെടുത്തുന്നതുമായി ബന്ധപ്പെട്ട വാചകങ്ങൾ അംഗീകരിക്കുക.]

Fleet Manager Terms & Conditions

EVsEye Fleet Manager App | Fleet operator: {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}
Draft version: 1.0.0 | Effective date: to be assigned at publication

[CLIENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Confirm client legal name, contacts, authority and escalation rules, enabled financial actions, and legal approval before publication.]

1. Who these terms apply to

These terms govern access to the EVsEye Fleet Manager App by an individual authorised by {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} to manage its fleet operations. “{{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}” means the fleet operator identified in the applicable employment or service arrangement. “EV Spares” means EV Spares India Pvt Ltd, which provides the EVsEye platform. “You” means the authorised Fleet Manager. These terms govern use of the App; your employment, compensation, and authority to act for {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} are governed by your separate arrangement with {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}.

2. Account and authority

Use only the account assigned to you. Keep your phone, OTPs, and access credentials secure; do not share them or allow another person to work under your identity. Your access is limited to the locations, riders, vehicles, and actions assigned by {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}. Inform {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} promptly if your device, account, or credentials are lost or compromised. {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} may change your role or withdraw access when your duties change.

3. Operational records and decisions

Enter accurate, timely information about rider onboarding, identity and document review, vehicle inspection, allocation, handover, return, incidents, maintenance, and other enabled workflows. Check original evidence where {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s procedure requires it. Do not approve, reject, change, or delete a record without a legitimate operational reason. Record the reason for significant decisions when the App asks for one. A status shown by the App is an operational record, not a substitute for any required physical check, signed agreement, or legal approval.

4. Vehicles, riders, and safety

Follow {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s safety, inspection, allocation, and escalation procedures. Do not release an unsafe or ineligible vehicle, override a failed check, or knowingly allocate a vehicle to a person who has not met applicable requirements. Report accidents, theft, damage, battery issues, breakdowns, and suspected misuse promptly through the designated process. Use rider and vehicle information only to carry out authorised duties.

5. Documents, photographs, and verification

Upload only relevant and genuine documents and photographs. Do not alter evidence to misrepresent its content. Where the App offers third-party verification, treat the result as one part of the applicable review process and follow {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s procedure for exceptions. Do not download, copy, forward, or store rider identity documents outside approved systems unless {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} expressly authorises it and a lawful purpose requires it.

6. Payments and financial records

If your role includes deposits, rent, refunds, wallet adjustments, or invoices, enter transactions accurately and use only approved payment channels. Do not request payment to a personal account, promise an undisclosed fee waiver, or make an unapproved adjustment. The App may record who performed an action and when. Any authority to collect or approve money comes from {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s separate policy and assigned permissions.

7. Confidentiality and personal information

Rider, staff, vehicle, financial, and business information visible in the App is confidential. Access only records needed for your assigned work; do not use them for personal purposes or share them with unauthorised people. Follow {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s privacy and data-handling instructions and the Fleet Manager Privacy Policy presented separately in the App. Report an accidental disclosure or suspected data incident promptly. This clause does not prevent a disclosure required by law or a protected report to a competent authority.

8. Acceptable use

Do not impersonate another user, submit false information, manipulate location or vehicle data, bypass permissions, probe the service for vulnerabilities, introduce harmful software, or use the App for harassment or unlawful activity. Do not use automated access or extract bulk records without written authorisation. Use App features only for the purposes made available to your role.

9. Availability and changes

Features depend on {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s configuration and may change as its operations change. Connectivity, device, and third-party failures can interrupt access. Keep an appropriate manual escalation route for urgent safety decisions. Material changes to these terms will be presented for acceptance when required; the App records the version and time accepted.

10. Suspension and end of access

{{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} may suspend or end your access because of a role change, security concern, suspected misuse, or the end of your arrangement with {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}. Return company devices and records and stop using copied information when access ends, subject to lawful retention and reporting obligations. Suspected wrongdoing should be reviewed under {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s applicable process; an App restriction alone is not a final employment decision.

11. Responsibility and disputes

These terms do not remove rights or obligations that cannot legally be excluded. Your separate agreement with {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} controls employment or service matters. Indian law applies to these App terms, subject to mandatory law and the jurisdiction of legally competent courts or tribunals. Concerns about fleet operations should first be raised with {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}; platform access or technical concerns may be raised with EV Spares.

12. Contacts

{{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} fleet operations: [confirm legal name, postal address, authorised email, and support phone before publication].

EV Spares platform support: office@evsparesindia.com.

Notices may be sent through the App or to a contact address you provide, subject to applicable law.

Rider Privacy Policy

EVsEye Rider App | Fleet Operator: {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}
Effective date: 01 October 2026 | Version: 1.0.0

This Policy explains how personal information is used when a Rider uses the EVsEye Rider App for {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}. It applies to the features made available to that Rider. If a feature is not enabled, the information needed only for that feature is not requested through it.

1. Who is responsible for your information

{{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}, [CLIENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: client location], decides how Rider information is used for onboarding, identity and eligibility checks, vehicle allocation, payments, and fleet operations. EV Spares India Pvt Ltd independently decides how information is used for EVsEye account security, platform support, and service analytics. EV Spares also operates the EVsEye platform on {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s behalf for {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s Rider operations. Contact details for both organisations are in section 14.

2. Information we collect

Depending on the enabled service, information may include your name, mobile number, date of birth, address, photograph, emergency or reference contacts, driving licence, onboarding answers, vehicle allocation and usage, payment and wallet transactions, support requests, training completion, and referral records. Identity checks may use PAN, Aadhaar-related verification information, and bank-account verification information where requested in the App. The specific fields required for a feature are shown when you provide them.

3. Identity verification and Aadhaar

Where an identity check is required, verification information is shared with Sandbox, our KYC service provider, for the requested check. The platform stores verification results and masked identifiers needed to administer the check; identity numbers are not displayed publicly. Aadhaar verification, if enabled, is used only for the disclosed identity-check purpose. Riders may ask what verification information is held about them using the contact details below.

4. Location, vehicle IoT, and app permissions

If you choose to use nearby-hub features and grant location permission, the App uses your phone's location while the App is in use to find relevant hubs. The App does not collect phone location in the background for {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} Riders. A vehicle with GPS or IoT hardware can independently transmit its location, battery, speed, ignition, and other vehicle-status or safety events. That hardware can operate when the App is closed and may continue operating outside an active shift while powered. Vehicle IoT information is used for fleet operations, safety, maintenance, and theft or incident investigation.

5. Face verification

Face matching and liveness verification are not active for {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} Riders. If either is introduced, we will provide a separate explanation of the images and results collected, the provider, retention, and available choices before use.

6. Why we use information

{{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} uses Rider information to create and manage Rider accounts, verify identity and eligibility, allocate and administer vehicles, manage rent, deposits, invoices and payments, provide training and support, maintain vehicle safety, investigate incidents and suspected fraud, and meet applicable legal obligations. EV Spares uses information to secure accounts and the EVsEye service, respond to platform support requests, troubleshoot and improve service reliability, and analyse service use. Referral information is used only where a referral feature is enabled.

7. Notice, permissions, and choices

We present the information requested for each feature when it is collected. Where consent is required, it is requested for the stated purpose and may be withdrawn as applicable under law by contacting us. Optional phone-location permission can be denied or changed in your device settings; nearby-hub results may then be unavailable or less relevant. Withdrawal of information necessary to provide a requested Rider service may limit that service, subject to legal and contractual obligations.

8. Sharing and service providers

Information is shared only as needed for the purposes above with authorised {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} personnel and EV Spares platform personnel, and with service providers under appropriate access controls. Current or applicable providers include Sandbox for enabled KYC checks, Razorpay and Cashfree for payment processing, MSG91 for email delivery, and Amazon Web Services for hosting. Where a feature is enabled, an SMS provider may process a phone number and one-time code, and a map or routing service may process a location used for a route or nearby-hub search. A provider receives only the information needed for its task. Information may also be disclosed to insurers, maintenance partners, or authorities where needed for a service, claim, safety matter, or legal requirement.

9. Client separation and access

The platform separates {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s operational data from other fleet operators' data. Access is limited by user role and the operational task. EV Spares staff may access information for approved support, security, maintenance, or legal purposes; access is not represented as zero. Requests for emergency or legally compelled access are handled according to the applicable process.

10. Storage, retention, and security

Core platform information is hosted on Amazon Web Services infrastructure in India. The exact AWS region can vary by deployment. A service provider's processing location may differ; information about a specific provider can be requested using the contacts below. Access controls, audit records, and technical safeguards are used to protect information according to the service configuration.

KYC and identity-check records, vehicle GPS/IoT history, and support records are retained for up to one year from collection, unless a longer period is necessary for an active legal hold, investigation, dispute, or applicable law. Payment, invoice, tax, and accounting records are retained for the period required by applicable law; where GST record-keeping rules apply, this is generally at least 72 months from the due date of the annual return for the relevant year, and longer where proceedings require it. Account and active vehicle-allocation information is retained while needed to provide and administer the Rider service, then reviewed for deletion or de-identification subject to legal and dispute requirements. Retention and deletion are administered by the responsible teams.

11. Your rights and grievances

Subject to applicable law, you may request information about processing, correction or updating of inaccurate information, erasure where appropriate, withdrawal of consent where applicable, and resolution of a grievance. Send a request to the privacy contact in section 14. We may verify your identity before acting and may retain information when a legal obligation, live dispute, or other lawful ground requires it. Any applicable nomination right may be exercised through the same contact.

12. Age and eligibility

The Rider service is intended for adults aged 18 or older. {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} does not knowingly onboard a minor as a vehicle Rider. If information about a minor is submitted in error, contact us so it can be reviewed and corrected or deleted as appropriate.

13. Security incidents and policy changes

The responsible organisation will assess suspected security incidents and provide notices when required by applicable law. Material changes to this Policy will be communicated through the App or another appropriate channel. The current version and effective date will be shown with the Policy; renewed consent will be sought when required.

14. Contact details

{{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} (Rider operations), [CLIENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: client location]: [CLIENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: client support email], [CLIENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: client support phone]. Privacy and grievance contact: [CLIENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: client grievance officer], at the {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} contact above. EV Spares India Pvt Ltd (EVsEye platform): office@evsparesindia.com.

पुढे जाण्यापूर्वी

गोपनीयता सूचना आणि संमती पत्र

'डिजिटल वैयक्तिक डेटा संरक्षण कायदा २०२३' (Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023) अंतर्गत वैयक्तिक डेटा संकलनासाठी संमती पत्र.

[CLIENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: प्रकाशित करण्यापूर्वी डेटा फिड्युशियरी (data fiduciary), DPO संपर्क तपशील, डेटाचा प्रत्येक प्रकार, स्रोत आणि सामायिक करण्याचा उद्देश यांची खात्री करा.]

डेटा संकलनाचा उद्देश

{{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} च्या प्लॅटफॉर्मवर रायडर्सना (वापरकर्त्यांना) सेवांचा लाभ घेण्यासाठी समाविष्ट करणे आणि त्यानंतरच्या व्यवहारांची प्रक्रिया सुलभ करणे.

संकलित केल्या जाणाऱ्या डेटाचे प्रकार

{{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} खालील वैयक्तिक डेटा संकलित करेल:

ओळख पटवणारी माहिती (PAN, नाव, वडिलांचे नाव आणि जन्मतारीख).

पत्त्याचा एक पुरावा (आधार, ड्रायव्हिंग लायसन्स, पासपोर्ट किंवा इतर अधिकृतपणे वैध दस्तऐवज).

संपर्क माहिती (ईमेल पत्ता आणि फोन नंबर).

आर्थिक माहिती (निव्वळ संपत्ती किंवा उत्पन्नाचे विवरण), लागू असल्यास. [CLIENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: हा डेटा संकलित केला जातो का याची खात्री करा.]

क्रेडिट माहिती डेटा. [CLIENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: हा डेटा संकलित केला जातो का याची खात्री करा आणि संबंधित उद्देश नमूद करा.]

डेटा संकलनाचे स्रोत

NSDL. [CLIENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: NSDL हा कार्यरत स्रोत असल्याची खात्री करा.]

सरकारी, वैधानिक किंवा नियामक प्राधिकरणांकडील डेटाबेस. [CLIENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: लागू होणारे स्रोत निश्चित करा.]

ऑनबोर्डिंग करणारी संस्था किंवा वापरकर्ता.

डेटा सामायिकरण

{{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} ला वैधानिक, नियामक आणि सरकारी प्राधिकरणांशी; व्यवसाय आणि कामकाजाच्या उद्देशांसाठी नियुक्त केलेल्या सेवा प्रदात्यांशी; आणि कंपनीद्वारे प्रदान केल्या जाणाऱ्या सेवा सुलभ करण्यात सहभागी असलेल्या पक्षांशी डेटा सामायिक करण्याचा अधिकार आहे. [CLIENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: प्रत्येक श्रेणीसाठी प्राप्तकर्ते, उद्देश आणि कायदेशीर आधार यांची खात्री करा.]

डेटा प्रिन्सिपलचे (डेटा मालकाचे) अधिकार

तुमच्या संमतीने प्रक्रिया केलेल्या वैयक्तिक डेटामध्ये सुधारणा, पूर्तता, अद्ययावत करणे आणि तो काढून टाकणे (डिलीट करणे) यांची विनंती तुम्ही करू शकता आणि कोणत्याही वेळी तुमची संमती मागे घेऊ शकता. या अधिकारांचा वापर करण्यासाठी, कंपनीशी [CLIENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: पडताळणी केलेला DPO किंवा तक्रार निवारण ईमेल नमूद करा] येथे संपर्क साधा.

संमती मागे घेण्याची विनंती केली असली तरीही, कंपनी लागू कायद्यानुसार विहित कालावधीसाठी आणि संमती मागे घेण्यापूर्वी सुरू केलेल्या व्यवहारांसाठी डेटा राखून ठेवू शकते. तक्रार किंवा गाऱ्हाणे असल्यास, [CLIENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: पडताळणी केलेला तक्रार निवारण संपर्क] येथे संपर्क साधा. न सुटलेली तक्रार लागू कायद्यानुसार डेटा संरक्षण मंडळाकडे पाठवली जाऊ शकते. [ग्राहकाने पुनरावलोकन करणे आवश्यक: प्रकाशित करण्यापूर्वी मूळ फॉर्ममधील ९०-दिवसांच्या तक्रार निवारण प्रक्रियेचा मजकूर तपासा.]

घोषणा

मी घोषित करतो की, मला या संमती पत्रातील मुद्दे समजले आहेत आणि मी डेटा धारक या नात्याने सहमत आहे. ॲपमधील स्वीकृती चेकबॉक्स मूळ फॉर्ममधील कागदी सही, नाव आणि पदनामाच्या ओळींची जागा घेतो. [ग्राहकाने पुनरावलोकन करणे आवश्यक: इलेक्ट्रॉनिक स्वीकृतीच्या मजकुराला मान्यता द्या.]

Rider Privacy Policy

EVsEye Rider App | Fleet Operator: {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}
Effective date: 01 October 2026 | Version: 1.0.0

This Policy explains how personal information is used when a Rider uses the EVsEye Rider App for {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}. It applies to the features made available to that Rider. If a feature is not enabled, the information needed only for that feature is not requested through it.

1. Who is responsible for your information

{{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}, [CLIENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: client location], decides how Rider information is used for onboarding, identity and eligibility checks, vehicle allocation, payments, and fleet operations. EV Spares India Pvt Ltd independently decides how information is used for EVsEye account security, platform support, and service analytics. EV Spares also operates the EVsEye platform on {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s behalf for {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s Rider operations. Contact details for both organisations are in section 14.

2. Information we collect

Depending on the enabled service, information may include your name, mobile number, date of birth, address, photograph, emergency or reference contacts, driving licence, onboarding answers, vehicle allocation and usage, payment and wallet transactions, support requests, training completion, and referral records. Identity checks may use PAN, Aadhaar-related verification information, and bank-account verification information where requested in the App. The specific fields required for a feature are shown when you provide them.

3. Identity verification and Aadhaar

Where an identity check is required, verification information is shared with Sandbox, our KYC service provider, for the requested check. The platform stores verification results and masked identifiers needed to administer the check; identity numbers are not displayed publicly. Aadhaar verification, if enabled, is used only for the disclosed identity-check purpose. Riders may ask what verification information is held about them using the contact details below.

4. Location, vehicle IoT, and app permissions

If you choose to use nearby-hub features and grant location permission, the App uses your phone's location while the App is in use to find relevant hubs. The App does not collect phone location in the background for {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} Riders. A vehicle with GPS or IoT hardware can independently transmit its location, battery, speed, ignition, and other vehicle-status or safety events. That hardware can operate when the App is closed and may continue operating outside an active shift while powered. Vehicle IoT information is used for fleet operations, safety, maintenance, and theft or incident investigation.

5. Face verification

Face matching and liveness verification are not active for {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} Riders. If either is introduced, we will provide a separate explanation of the images and results collected, the provider, retention, and available choices before use.

6. Why we use information

{{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} uses Rider information to create and manage Rider accounts, verify identity and eligibility, allocate and administer vehicles, manage rent, deposits, invoices and payments, provide training and support, maintain vehicle safety, investigate incidents and suspected fraud, and meet applicable legal obligations. EV Spares uses information to secure accounts and the EVsEye service, respond to platform support requests, troubleshoot and improve service reliability, and analyse service use. Referral information is used only where a referral feature is enabled.

7. Notice, permissions, and choices

We present the information requested for each feature when it is collected. Where consent is required, it is requested for the stated purpose and may be withdrawn as applicable under law by contacting us. Optional phone-location permission can be denied or changed in your device settings; nearby-hub results may then be unavailable or less relevant. Withdrawal of information necessary to provide a requested Rider service may limit that service, subject to legal and contractual obligations.

8. Sharing and service providers

Information is shared only as needed for the purposes above with authorised {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} personnel and EV Spares platform personnel, and with service providers under appropriate access controls. Current or applicable providers include Sandbox for enabled KYC checks, Razorpay and Cashfree for payment processing, MSG91 for email delivery, and Amazon Web Services for hosting. Where a feature is enabled, an SMS provider may process a phone number and one-time code, and a map or routing service may process a location used for a route or nearby-hub search. A provider receives only the information needed for its task. Information may also be disclosed to insurers, maintenance partners, or authorities where needed for a service, claim, safety matter, or legal requirement.

9. Client separation and access

The platform separates {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s operational data from other fleet operators' data. Access is limited by user role and the operational task. EV Spares staff may access information for approved support, security, maintenance, or legal purposes; access is not represented as zero. Requests for emergency or legally compelled access are handled according to the applicable process.

10. Storage, retention, and security

Core platform information is hosted on Amazon Web Services infrastructure in India. The exact AWS region can vary by deployment. A service provider's processing location may differ; information about a specific provider can be requested using the contacts below. Access controls, audit records, and technical safeguards are used to protect information according to the service configuration.

KYC and identity-check records, vehicle GPS/IoT history, and support records are retained for up to one year from collection, unless a longer period is necessary for an active legal hold, investigation, dispute, or applicable law. Payment, invoice, tax, and accounting records are retained for the period required by applicable law; where GST record-keeping rules apply, this is generally at least 72 months from the due date of the annual return for the relevant year, and longer where proceedings require it. Account and active vehicle-allocation information is retained while needed to provide and administer the Rider service, then reviewed for deletion or de-identification subject to legal and dispute requirements. Retention and deletion are administered by the responsible teams.

11. Your rights and grievances

Subject to applicable law, you may request information about processing, correction or updating of inaccurate information, erasure where appropriate, withdrawal of consent where applicable, and resolution of a grievance. Send a request to the privacy contact in section 14. We may verify your identity before acting and may retain information when a legal obligation, live dispute, or other lawful ground requires it. Any applicable nomination right may be exercised through the same contact.

12. Age and eligibility

The Rider service is intended for adults aged 18 or older. {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} does not knowingly onboard a minor as a vehicle Rider. If information about a minor is submitted in error, contact us so it can be reviewed and corrected or deleted as appropriate.

13. Security incidents and policy changes

The responsible organisation will assess suspected security incidents and provide notices when required by applicable law. Material changes to this Policy will be communicated through the App or another appropriate channel. The current version and effective date will be shown with the Policy; renewed consent will be sought when required.

14. Contact details

{{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} (Rider operations), [CLIENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: client location]: [CLIENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: client support email], [CLIENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: client support phone]. Privacy and grievance contact: [CLIENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: client grievance officer], at the {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} contact above. EV Spares India Pvt Ltd (EVsEye platform): office@evsparesindia.com.

templates.title: ଗୋପନୀୟତା ବିଜ୍ଞପ୍ତି ଏବଂ ସହମତି ଫର୍ମ
templates.content:
ଆଗକୁ ବଢ଼ିବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ

ଗୋପନୀୟତା ବିଜ୍ଞପ୍ତି ଏବଂ ସହମତି ଫର୍ମ

'ଡିଜିଟାଲ୍ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଗତ ତଥ୍ୟ ସୁରକ୍ଷା ଆଇନ୍ ୨୦୨୩' (Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023) ଅଧୀନରେ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଗତ ତଥ୍ୟ ସଂଗ୍ରହ ପାଇଁ ସହମତି ଫର୍ମ।

[କ୍ଲାଏଣ୍ଟଙ୍କ ସମୀକ୍ଷା ଆବଶ୍ୟକ: ପ୍ରକାଶ କରିବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ତଥ୍ୟ ନ୍ୟସ୍ତକାରୀ (data fiduciary), DPO ଯୋଗାଯୋଗ ବିବରଣୀ, ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ତଥ୍ୟ ବର୍ଗ, ଉତ୍ସ ଏବଂ ବାଣ୍ଟିବାର ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ ନିଶ୍ଚିତ କରନ୍ତୁ।]

ତଥ୍ୟ ସଂଗ୍ରହର ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ

{{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} ର ସେବା ଗ୍ରହଣ କରିବା ଏବଂ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ କାରବାରକୁ ସୁଗମ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ପ୍ଲାଟଫର୍ମରେ ରାଇଡର୍‌ମାନଙ୍କୁ (riders) ସାମିଲ କରିବା।

ସଂଗୃହିତ ତଥ୍ୟର ପ୍ରକାର

{{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଗତ ତଥ୍ୟ ସଂଗ୍ରହ କରିବ:

ପରିଚୟ ସମ୍ବନ୍ଧୀୟ ସୂଚନା (PAN, ନାମ, ପିତାଙ୍କ ନାମ ଏବଂ ଜନ୍ମ ତାରିଖ)।

ଠିକଣାର ପ୍ରମାଣ (ଆଧାର, ଡ୍ରାଇଭିଂ ଲାଇସେନ୍ସ, ପାସପୋର୍ଟ କିମ୍ବା ଅନ୍ୟ କୌଣସି ସରକାରୀ ସ୍ୱୀକୃତିପ୍ରାପ୍ତ ବୈଧ ଦସ୍ତାବିଜ୍)।

ଯୋଗାଯୋଗ ସୂଚନା (ଇମେଲ୍ ଠିକଣା ଏବଂ ଫୋନ୍ ନମ୍ବର)।

ଆର୍ଥିକ ସୂଚନା (ନିଟ୍ ସମ୍ପତ୍ତି ମୂଲ୍ୟ ବା ଆୟ ବିବରଣୀ), ଯଦି ପ୍ରଯୁଜ୍ୟ ହୁଏ। [କ୍ଲାଏଣ୍ଟଙ୍କ ସମୀକ୍ଷା ଆବଶ୍ୟକ: ଏହା ସଂଗ୍ରହ କରାଯାଉଛି କି ନାହିଁ ନିଶ୍ଚିତ କରନ୍ତୁ।]

କ୍ରେଡିଟ୍ ସୂଚନା ତଥ୍ୟ। [କ୍ଲାଏଣ୍ଟଙ୍କ ସମୀକ୍ଷା ଆବଶ୍ୟକ: ଏହା ସଂଗ୍ରହ କରାଯାଉଛି କି ନାହିଁ ନିଶ୍ଚିତ କରନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ସମ୍ପୃକ୍ତ ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ ଉଲ୍ଲେଖ କରନ୍ତୁ।]

ତଥ୍ୟ ସଂଗ୍ରହର ଉତ୍ସ

NSDL। [କ୍ଲାଏଣ୍ଟଙ୍କ ସମୀକ୍ଷା ଆବଶ୍ୟକ: NSDL ଏକ ସକ୍ରିୟ ଉତ୍ସ ବୋଲି ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରନ୍ତୁ।]

ସରକାରୀ, ବୈଧାନିକ କିମ୍ବା ନିୟାମକ କର୍ତ୍ତୃପକ୍ଷଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା ପରିଚାଳିତ ଡାଟାବେସ୍। [କ୍ଲାଏଣ୍ଟଙ୍କ ସମୀକ୍ଷା ଆବଶ୍ୟକ: ପ୍ରଯୁଜ୍ୟ ଉତ୍ସଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଚିହ୍ନଟ କରନ୍ତୁ।]

ସାମିଲ ହେଉଥିବା ସଂସ୍ଥା କିମ୍ବା ବ୍ୟବହାରକାରୀ।

ତଥ୍ୟ ଆଦାନପ୍ରଦାନ

{{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} ବୈଧାନିକ, ନିୟାମକ ଏବଂ ସରକାରୀ କର୍ତ୍ତୃପକ୍ଷ; ବ୍ୟବସାୟିକ ଓ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକ୍ଷମ ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟରେ ନିୟୋଜିତ ସେବା ପ୍ରଦାନକାରୀ; ଏବଂ କମ୍ପାନୀ ଦ୍ୱାରା ପ୍ରଦତ୍ତ ସେବାକୁ ସୁଗମ କରିବାରେ ଜଡ

[CLIENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Source text is incomplete here. Supply the remainder of data sharing, data principal rights and grievance sections before publication.]

ଯଦି କୌଣସି ଅଭିଯୋଗର ସମାଧାନ ହୁଏନାହିଁ, ତେବେ ପ୍ରଯୁଜ୍ୟ ଆଇନ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ ଏହାକୁ 'ଡାଟା ସୁରକ୍ଷା ବୋର୍ଡ' (Data Protection Board) ନିକଟକୁ ଅଗ୍ରସର କରାଯାଇପାରିବ। [କ୍ଲାଏଣ୍ଟଙ୍କ ସମୀକ୍ଷା ଆବଶ୍ୟକ: ପ୍ରକାଶ କରିବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ମୂଳ ଫର୍ମରେ ଥିବା ୯୦-ଦିନିଆ ଅଗ୍ରସରଣ (escalation) ସମ୍ବନ୍ଧୀୟ ଭାଷା ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରନ୍ତୁ।]

ଘୋଷଣା

ମୁଁ ଘୋଷଣା କରୁଛି ଯେ ମୁଁ ଏହି ସମ୍ମତି ପତ୍ରର ବିଷୟବସ୍ତୁ ବୁଝିପାରିଛି ଏବଂ 'ଡାଟା ପ୍ରିନ୍ସିପାଲ୍' (data principal) ଭାବରେ ଏଥିରେ ସହମତି ପ୍ରଦାନ କରୁଛି। ଆପ୍ (app) ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଥିବା ସ୍ୱୀକୃତି ଚେକ୍‌ବକ୍ସ (checkbox), ମୂଳ ଫର୍ମରେ ଥିବା କାଗଜ-ଭିତ୍ତିକ ସ୍ୱାକ୍ଷର, ନାମ ଏବଂ ପଦବୀ ସ୍ଥାନକୁ ବଦଳାଇଥାଏ। [କ୍ଲାଏଣ୍ଟଙ୍କ ସମୀକ୍ଷା ଆବଶ୍ୟକ: ଇଲେକ୍ଟ୍ରୋନିକ୍ ସ୍ୱୀକୃତି ସମ୍ବନ୍ଧୀୟ ଭାଷାକୁ ଅନୁମୋଦନ କରନ୍ତୁ।]

3. Operational records and decisions

4. Vehicles, riders, and safety

Do not release an unsafe or ineligible vehicle, override a failed check, or knowingly allocate a vehicle to a person who has not met applicable requirements. Where the App offers third-party verification, treat the result as one part of the applicable review process and follow {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s procedure for exceptions. Do not download, copy, forward, or store rider identity documents outside approved systems unless {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} expressly authorises it and a lawful purpose requires it.

6. Payments and financial records

Any authority to collect or approve money comes from {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s separate policy and assigned permissions.

7. Confidentiality and personal information

Rider, staff, vehicle, financial, and business information visible in the App is confidential. Access only records needed for your assigned work; do not use them for personal purposes or share them with unauthorised people. Follow {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s privacy and data-handling instructions and the Fleet Manager Privacy Policy presented separately in the App. Report an accidental disclosure or suspected data incident promptly. This clause does not prevent a disclosure required by law or a protected report to a competent authority.

8. Acceptable use

Do not impersonate another user, submit false information, manipulate location or vehicle data, bypass permissions, probe the service for vulnerabilities, introduce harmful software, or use the App for harassment or unlawful activity. Do not use automated access or extract bulk records without written authorisation. Use App features only for the purposes made available to your role.

9. Availability and changes

Features depend on {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s configuration and may change as its operations change. Connectivity, device, and third-party failures can interrupt access. Keep an appropriate manual escalation route for urgent safety decisions. Material changes to these terms will be presented for acceptance when required; the App records the version and time accepted.

10. Suspension and end of access

{{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} may suspend or end your access because of a role change, security concern, suspected misuse, or the end of your arrangement with {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}. Return company devices and records and stop using copied information when access ends, subject to lawful retention and reporting obligations. Suspected wrongdoing should be reviewed under {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s applicable process; an App restriction alone is not a final employment decision.

11. Responsibility and disputes

These terms do not remove rights or obligations that cannot legally be excluded. Your separate agreement with {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} controls employment or service matters. Indian law applies to these App terms, subject to mandatory law and the jurisdiction of legally competent courts or tribunals. Concerns about fleet operations should first be raised with {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}; platform access or technical concerns may be raised with EV Spares.

Rider Privacy Policy

EVsEye Rider App | Fleet Operator: {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}
Effective date: 01 October 2026 | Version: 1.0.0

This Policy explains how personal information is used when a Rider uses the EVsEye Rider App for {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}. It applies to the features made available to that Rider. If a feature is not enabled, the information needed only for that feature is not requested through it.

1. Who is responsible for your information

{{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}, [CLIENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: client location], decides how Rider information is used for onboarding, identity and eligibility checks, vehicle allocation, payments, and fleet operations. EV Spares India Pvt Ltd independently decides how information is used for EVsEye account security, platform support, and service analytics. EV Spares also operates the EVsEye platform on {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s behalf for {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s Rider operations. Contact details for both organisations are in section 14.

2. Information we collect

Depending on the enabled service, information may include your name, mobile number, date of birth, address, photograph, emergency or reference contacts, driving licence, onboarding answers, vehicle allocation and usage, payment and wallet transactions, support requests, training completion, and referral records. Identity checks may use PAN, Aadhaar-related verification information, and bank-account verification information where requested in the App. The specific fields required for a feature are shown when you provide them.

3. Identity verification and Aadhaar

Where an identity check is required, verification information is shared with Sandbox, our KYC service provider, for the requested check. The platform stores verification results and masked identifiers needed to administer the check; identity numbers are not displayed publicly. Aadhaar verification, if enabled, is used only for the disclosed identity-check purpose. Riders may ask what verification information is held about them using the contact details below.

4. Location, vehicle IoT, and app permissions

If you choose to use nearby-hub features and grant location permission, the App uses your phone's location while the App is in use to find relevant hubs. The App does not collect phone location in the background for {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} Riders. A vehicle with GPS or IoT hardware can independently transmit its location, battery, speed, ignition, and other vehicle-status or safety events. That hardware can operate when the App is closed and may continue operating outside an active shift while powered. Vehicle IoT information is used for fleet operations, safety, maintenance, and theft or incident investigation.

5. Face verification

Face matching and liveness verification are not active for {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} Riders. If either is introduced, we will provide a separate explanation of the images and results collected, the provider, retention, and available choices before use.

6. Why we use information

{{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} uses Rider information to create and manage Rider accounts, verify identity and eligibility, allocate and administer vehicles, manage rent, deposits, invoices and payments, provide training and support, maintain vehicle safety, investigate incidents and suspected fraud, and meet applicable legal obligations. EV Spares uses information to secure accounts and the EVsEye service, respond to platform support requests, troubleshoot and improve service reliability, and analyse service use. Referral information is used only where a referral feature is enabled.

7. Notice, permissions, and choices

We present the information requested for each feature when it is collected. Where consent is required, it is requested for the stated purpose and may be withdrawn as applicable under law by contacting us. Optional phone-location permission can be denied or changed in your device settings; nearby-hub results may then be unavailable or less relevant. Withdrawal of information necessary to provide a requested Rider service may limit that service, subject to legal and contractual obligations.

8. Sharing and service providers

Information is shared only as needed for the purposes above with authorised {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} personnel and EV Spares platform personnel, and with service providers under appropriate access controls. Current or applicable providers include Sandbox for enabled KYC checks, Razorpay and Cashfree for payment processing, MSG91 for email delivery, and Amazon Web Services for hosting. Where a feature is enabled, an SMS provider may process a phone number and one-time code, and a map or routing service may process a location used for a route or nearby-hub search. A provider receives only the information needed for its task. Information may also be disclosed to insurers, maintenance partners, or authorities where needed for a service, claim, safety matter, or legal requirement.

9. Client separation and access

The platform separates {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s operational data from other fleet operators' data. Access is limited by user role and the operational task. EV Spares staff may access information for approved support, security, maintenance, or legal purposes; access is not represented as zero. Requests for emergency or legally compelled access are handled according to the applicable process.

10. Storage, retention, and security

Core platform information is hosted on Amazon Web Services infrastructure in India. The exact AWS region can vary by deployment. A service provider's processing location may differ; information about a specific provider can be requested using the contacts below. Access controls, audit records, and technical safeguards are used to protect information according to the service configuration.

KYC and identity-check records, vehicle GPS/IoT history, and support records are retained for up to one year from collection, unless a longer period is necessary for an active legal hold, investigation, dispute, or applicable law. Payment, invoice, tax, and accounting records are retained for the period required by applicable law; where GST record-keeping rules apply, this is generally at least 72 months from the due date of the annual return for the relevant year, and longer where proceedings require it. Account and active vehicle-allocation information is retained while needed to provide and administer the Rider service, then reviewed for deletion or de-identification subject to legal and dispute requirements. Retention and deletion are administered by the responsible teams.

11. Your rights and grievances

Subject to applicable law, you may request information about processing, correction or updating of inaccurate information, erasure where appropriate, withdrawal of consent where applicable, and resolution of a grievance. Send a request to the privacy contact in section 14. We may verify your identity before acting and may retain information when a legal obligation, live dispute, or other lawful ground requires it. Any applicable nomination right may be exercised through the same contact.

12. Age and eligibility

The Rider service is intended for adults aged 18 or older. {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} does not knowingly onboard a minor as a vehicle Rider. If information about a minor is submitted in error, contact us so it can be reviewed and corrected or deleted as appropriate.

13. Security incidents and policy changes

The responsible organisation will assess suspected security incidents and provide notices when required by applicable law. Material changes to this Policy will be communicated through the App or another appropriate channel. The current version and effective date will be shown with the Policy; renewed consent will be sought when required.

14. Contact details

templates.title: ਗੋਪਨੀਯਤਾ ਨੋਟਿਸ ਅਤੇ ਸਹਿਮਤੀ ਫਾਰਮ
templates.content:
ਅੱਗੇ ਵਧਣ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ

ਗੋਪਨੀਯਤਾ ਨੋਟਿਸ ਅਤੇ ਸਹਿਮਤੀ ਫਾਰਮ

'ਡਿਜੀਟਲ ਨਿੱਜੀ ਡਾਟਾ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਆ ਐਕਟ 2023' (Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023) ਦੇ ਤਹਿਤ ਨਿੱਜੀ ਡਾਟਾ ਇਕੱਤਰ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਸਹਿਮਤੀ ਫਾਰਮ।

[ਕਲਾਇੰਟ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਸਮੀਖਿਆ ਲੋੜੀਂਦੀ: ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ਼ਿਤ ਕਰਨ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਡਾਟਾ ਫਿਡਿਊਸ਼ਰੀ (ਡਾਟਾ ਰੱਖਿਅਕ), DPO ਸੰਪਰਕ, ਹਰੇਕ ਡਾਟਾ ਸ਼੍ਰੇਣੀ, ਸਰੋਤ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਂਝਾ ਕਰਨ ਦੇ ਉਦੇਸ਼ ਦੀ ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਕਰੋ।]

ਡਾਟਾ ਇਕੱਤਰ ਕਰਨ ਦਾ ਉਦੇਸ਼

{{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} ਦੇ ਪਲੇਟਫਾਰਮ 'ਤੇ ਰਾਈਡਰਾਂ (ਸਵਾਰੀਆਂ/ਚਾਲਕਾਂ) ਨੂੰ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਕਰਨਾ ਤਾਂ ਜੋ ਉਹ ਇਸ ਦੀਆਂ ਸੇਵਾਵਾਂ ਦਾ ਲਾਭ ਲੈ ਸਕਣ ਅਤੇ ਬਾਅਦ ਦੇ ਲੈਣ-ਦੇਣ ਨੂੰ ਸੁਚਾਰੂ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਸਕੇ।

ਇਕੱਤਰ ਕੀਤੇ ਜਾਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਡਾਟਾ ਦੀਆਂ ਕਿਸਮਾਂ

{{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} ਹੇਠ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਨਿੱਜੀ ਡਾਟਾ ਇਕੱਤਰ ਕਰੇਗਾ:

ਪਛਾਣ ਸੰਬੰਧੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ (PAN, ਨਾਮ, ਪਿਤਾ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਅਤੇ ਜਨਮ ਮਿਤੀ)।

ਪਤੇ ਦਾ ਇੱਕ ਸਬੂਤ (ਆਧਾਰ, ਡਰਾਈਵਿੰਗ ਲਾਇਸੈਂਸ, ਪਾਸਪੋਰਟ ਜਾਂ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਰ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਤੌਰ 'ਤੇ ਵੈਧ ਦਸਤਾਵੇਜ਼)।

ਸੰਪਰਕ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ (ਈਮੇਲ ਪਤਾ ਅਤੇ ਫ਼ੋਨ ਨੰਬਰ)।

ਵਿੱਤੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ (ਕੁੱਲ ਜਾਇਦਾਦ ਜਾਂ ਆਮਦਨ ਦਾ ਵੇਰਵਾ), ਜੇਕਰ ਲਾਗੂ ਹੋਵੇ। [ਕਲਾਇੰਟ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਸਮੀਖਿਆ ਲੋੜੀਂਦੀ: ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਕਰੋ ਕਿ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਇਕੱਤਰ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ।]

ਕ੍ਰੈਡਿਟ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਡਾਟਾ। [ਕਲਾਇੰਟ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਸਮੀਖਿਆ ਲੋੜੀਂਦੀ: ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਕਰੋ ਕਿ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਇਕੱਤਰ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਸੰਬੰਧਿਤ ਉਦੇਸ਼ ਦੱਸੋ।]

ਡਾਟਾ ਇਕੱਤਰ ਕਰਨ ਦੇ ਸਰੋਤ

NSDL। [ਕਲਾਇੰਟ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਸਮੀਖਿਆ ਲੋੜੀਂਦੀ: ਤਸਦੀਕ ਕਰੋ ਕਿ NSDL ਇੱਕ ਚਾਲੂ ਸਰੋਤ ਹੈ।]

ਸਰਕਾਰੀ, ਕਾਨੂੰਨੀ ਜਾਂ ਰੈਗੂਲੇਟਰੀ ਅਥਾਰਟੀਆਂ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਰੱਖ-ਰਖਾਅ ਕੀਤੇ ਗਏ ਡਾਟਾਬੇਸ। [ਕਲਾਇੰਟ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਸਮੀਖਿਆ ਲੋੜੀਂਦੀ: ਲਾਗੂ ਸਰੋਤਾਂ ਦੀ ਪਛਾਣ ਕਰੋ।]

ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੀ ਇਕਾਈ ਜਾਂ ਉਪਭੋਗਤਾ।

ਡਾਟਾ ਸਾਂਝਾ ਕਰਨਾ

{{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} ਕਾਨੂੰਨੀ, ਰੈਗੂਲੇਟਰੀ ਅਤੇ ਸਰਕਾਰੀ ਅਥਾਰਟੀਆਂ; ਵਪਾਰਕ ਅਤੇ ਸੰਚਾਲਨ ਉਦੇਸ਼ਾਂ ਲਈ ਲੱਗੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਦਾਤਾਵਾਂ; ਅਤੇ ਕੰਪਨੀ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਦਾਨ ਕੀਤੀਆਂ ਜਾਣ ਵਾਲੀਆਂ ਸੇਵਾਵਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸੁਚਾਰੂ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਵਿੱਚ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਧਿਰਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਡਾਟਾ ਸਾਂਝਾ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਹੈ। [ਕਲਾਇੰਟ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਸਮੀਖਿਆ ਲੋੜੀਂਦੀ: ਹਰੇਕ ਸ਼੍ਰੇਣੀ ਲਈ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਕਰਤਾਵਾਂ, ਉਦੇਸ਼ਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਕਾਨੂੰਨੀ ਆਧਾਰ ਦੀ ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਕਰੋ।]

ਡਾਟਾ ਪ੍ਰਿੰਸੀਪਲ (ਸੰਬੰਧਿਤ ਵਿਅਕਤੀ) ਦੇ ਅਧਿਕਾਰ

ਤੁਸੀਂ ਆਪਣੀ ਸਹਿਮਤੀ ਨਾਲ ਪ੍ਰੋਸੈਸ ਕੀਤੇ ਗਏ ਨਿੱਜੀ ਡਾਟਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਸੁਧਾਰ, ਪੂਰਤੀ, ਅੱਪਡੇਟ ਅਤੇ ਮਿਟਾਉਣ ਦੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ, ਅਤੇ ਕਿਸੇ ਵੀ ਸਮੇਂ ਸਹਿਮਤੀ ਵਾਪਸ ਲੈ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ। ਇਹਨਾਂ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਾਂ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ, ਕੰਪਨੀ ਨਾਲ ਸੰਪਰਕ

[CLIENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Source text is incomplete here. Supply the remainder of rights, withdrawal, retention and grievance sections before publication.]

ਜੇਕਰ ਕਿਸੇ ਸ਼ਿਕਾਇਤ ਦਾ ਨਿਪਟਾਰਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦਾ, ਤਾਂ ਲਾਗੂ ਕਾਨੂੰਨ ਦੇ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਇਸਨੂੰ 'ਡਾਟਾ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਆ ਬੋਰਡ' (Data Protection Board) ਕੋਲ ਅੱਗੇ ਭੇਜਿਆ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। [ਗਾਹਕ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਸਮੀਖਿਆ ਲੋੜੀਂਦੀ: ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ਼ਨ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਮੂਲ ਫਾਰਮ ਵਿੱਚ 90-ਦਿਨਾਂ ਦੀ 'ਐਸਕਲੇਸ਼ਨ' (ਅੱਗੇ ਭੇਜਣ) ਸਬੰਧੀ ਸ਼ਬਦਾਵਲੀ ਦੀ ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਕਰੋ।]

ਘੋਸ਼ਣਾ

ਮੈਂ ਘੋਸ਼ਣਾ ਕਰਦਾ/ਕਰਦੀ ਹਾਂ ਕਿ ਮੈਂ ਇਸ ਸਹਿਮਤੀ ਫਾਰਮ ਦੇ ਨੁਕਤਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਮਝ ਲਿਆ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ 'ਡਾਟਾ ਪ੍ਰਿੰਸੀਪਲ' (data principal) ਵਜੋਂ ਆਪਣੀ ਹੈਸੀਅਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਹਿਮਤੀ ਦਿੰਦਾ/ਦਿੰਦੀ ਹਾਂ। ਐਪ ਦੇ ਅੰਦਰ ਮੌਜੂਦ ਸਵੀਕ੍ਰਿਤੀ ਚੈੱਕਬਾਕਸ, ਮੂਲ ਫਾਰਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਾਗਜ਼ੀ ਦਸਤਖਤ, ਨਾਮ ਅਤੇ ਅਹੁਦੇ ਵਾਲੀਆਂ ਥਾਵਾਂ ਦੀ ਥਾਂ ਲੈਂਦਾ ਹੈ। [ਗਾਹਕ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਸਮੀਖਿਆ ਲੋੜੀਂਦੀ: ਇਲੈਕਟ੍ਰਾਨਿਕ ਸਵੀਕ੍ਰਿਤੀ ਸਬੰਧੀ ਸ਼ਬਦਾਵਲੀ ਨੂੰ ਮਨਜ਼ੂਰੀ ਦਿਓ।]

Fleet Manager Terms & Conditions

EVsEye Fleet Manager App | Fleet operator: {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}
Draft version: 1.0.0 | Effective date: to be assigned at publication

[CLIENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Confirm client legal name, contacts, authority and escalation rules, enabled financial actions, and legal approval before publication.]

1. Who these terms apply to

These terms govern access to the EVsEye Fleet Manager App by an individual authorised by {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} to manage its fleet operations. “{{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}” means the fleet operator identified in the applicable employment or service arrangement. “EV Spares” means EV Spares India Pvt Ltd, which provides the EVsEye platform. “You” means the authorised Fleet Manager. These terms govern use of the App; your employment, compensation, and authority to act for {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} are governed by your separate arrangement with {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}.

2. Account and authority

Use only the account assigned to you. Keep your phone, OTPs, and access credentials secure; do not share them or allow another person to work under your identity. Your access is limited to the locations, riders, vehicles, and actions assigned by {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}. Inform {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} promptly if your device, account, or credentials are lost or compromised. {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} may change your role or withdraw access when your duties change.

3. Operational records and decisions

Enter accurate, timely information about rider onboarding, identity and document review, vehicle inspection, allocation, handover, return, incidents, maintenance, and other enabled workflows. Check original evidence where {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s procedure requires it. Do not approve, reject, change, or delete a record without a legitimate operational reason. Record the reason for significant decisions when the App asks for one. A status shown by the App is an operational record, not a substitute for any required physical check, signed agreement, or legal approval.

4. Vehicles, riders, and safety

Follow {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s safety, inspection, allocation, and escalation procedures. Do not release an unsafe or ineligible vehicle, override a failed check, or knowingly allocate a vehicle to a person who has not met applicable requirements. Report accidents, theft, damage, battery issues, breakdowns, and suspected misuse promptly through the designated process. Use rider and vehicle information only to carry out authorised duties.

5. Documents, photographs, and verification

Upload only relevant and genuine documents and photographs. Do not alter evidence to misrepresent its content. Where the App offers third-party verification, treat the result as one part of the applicable review process and follow {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s procedure for exceptions. Do not download, copy, forward, or store rider identity documents outside approved systems unless {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} expressly authorises it and a lawful purpose requires it.

6. Payments and financial records

If your role includes deposits, rent, refunds, wallet adjustments, or invoices, enter transactions accurately and use only approved payment channels. Do not request payment to a personal account, promise an undisclosed fee waiver, or make an unapproved adjustment. The App may record who performed an action and when. Any authority to collect or approve money comes from {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s separate policy and assigned permissions.

7. Confidentiality and personal information

Rider, staff, vehicle, financial, and business information visible in the App is confidential. Access only records needed for your assigned work; do not use them for personal purposes or share them with unauthorised people. Follow {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s privacy and data-handling instructions and the Fleet Manager Privacy Policy presented separately in the App. Report an accidental disclosure or suspected data incident promptly. This clause does not prevent a disclosure required by law or a protected report to a competent authority.

8. Acceptable use

Do not impersonate another user, submit false information, manipulate location or vehicle data, bypass permissions, probe the service for vulnerabilities, introduce harmful software, or use the App for harassment or unlawful activity. Do not use automated access or extract bulk records without written authorisation. Use App features only for the purposes made available to your role.

9. Availability and changes

Features depend on {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s configuration and may change as its operations change. Connectivity, device, and third-party failures can interrupt access. Keep an appropriate manual escalation route for urgent safety decisions. Material changes to these terms will be presented for acceptance when required; the App records the version and time accepted.

10. Suspension and end of access

{{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} may suspend or end your access because of a role change, security concern, suspected misuse, or the end of your arrangement with {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}. Return company devices and records and stop using copied information when access ends, subject to lawful retention and reporting obligations. Suspected wrongdoing should be reviewed under {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}'s applicable process; an App restriction alone is not a final employment decision.

11. Responsibility and disputes

These terms do not remove rights or obligations that cannot legally be excluded. Your separate agreement with {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} controls employment or service matters. Indian law applies to these App terms, subject to mandatory law and the jurisdiction of legally competent courts or tribunals. Concerns about fleet operations should first be raised with {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}; platform access or technical concerns may be raised with EV Spares.

12. Contacts

{{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}} fleet operations: [confirm legal name, postal address, authorised email, and support phone before publication].

EV Spares platform support: office@evsparesindia.com.

Notices may be sent through the App or to a contact address you provide, subject to applicable law.
